notes.title: Devlog #1 - Trainer gestures
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38371058/c6c110f5c4f7d7269cffd6df6115b74d67f41dda.jpg
Our dolphin begins to respond to standard training. !

We have added gesture initiation. Gestures consist of movements after which the Dolphin begins to execute our commands. 

https://i.ibb.co/P1PsKHy/1.gif

https://i.ibb.co/tBr0PFs/2.gif

The gestures will consist of the movements of the controller in the air imitating acrobatics to be performed by the dolphin. 

It's getting interesting! Stay tuned, next DOLPHIN TRAINER VR development updates are coming soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38371058/9fd10616552289cdae7d10c1a76cdf73b678b1d8.jpg
